title: Aaron Burr's treason trial begins
summary: On this day in 1807, Aaron Burr went on trial for treason. A political outcast since his fatal duel with Alexander Hamilton, Burr was accused of levying war against the United States and preparing military forces to seize Mexico, then a territory of Spain. He was ultimately acquitted. For his next act, Burr fled to Europe, where he tried to convince Napoleon to conquer Spanish Florida.
